landing.automation.desc: Customers email your company inbox. An n8n workflow parses the message, creates a draft sales order, and routes it straight into your approval pipeline — zero manual entry.
landing.automation.step2: n8n parses and validates the order
landing.automation.step3: Draft sales order, ready to approve
landing.ai.title: An AI assistant that actually does the work
landing.ai.desc: A streaming LLM engine sits inside the app — grounded in your docs via RAG and wired to real tools, so it answers, navigates, and drafts instead of just chatting.
landing.ai.cap1: Chat with RAG over your knowledge base
landing.ai.cap2: Extract orders from free-text or email
landing.ai.cap3: Ask data in plain language → read-only SQL
landing.ai.example: Show this month's top 5 outlets by order value.
landing.faq.title: Questions, answered
landing.faq.q1: Is B2B CRM suitable for small field teams?
landing.faq.a1: Yes. Start with customers, outlets, and orders, then enable approvals and programs as your team grows.
landing.faq.a2: Before an order can be proposed, a model checks pricing, quantity, and discount risk and flags anything unusual for review.
landing.faq.q3: Can the email inbox create orders automatically?
landing.faq.a3: Yes. Inbound emails are parsed by an n8n workflow that drafts a sales order and routes it into your approval pipeline.
landing.faq.a4: B2B CRM runs in the browser and as a desktop app on Windows, macOS, and Linux via Tauri.
landing.faq.a5: Every transition records who, when, and why, giving you a complete audit trail across all documents.
